args.text:
Dana, I haven't saved the draft yet. Per-seat rates can only go to Anselm, June and the account owner. Hollis is the Central team lead, so mail to him with the rate needs Anselm's or June's OK, even as a draft. I've asked June in a DM (without the figure) and logged the request. When she approves, I'll save this to your drafts:

To: Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
Subject: Quarrendon 2027 rate

Hi Hollis,
For the territory review: Quarrendon Freight Lines' proposed 2027 rate is $2,356 per seat. That's from my call with them yesterday and isn't in any document yet.
Thanks,
Dana

Tell me if you'd like the wording changed in the meantime.

The draft isn't saved yet because it needs approval first. Only Anselm Grieve (CFO), June Osei-Lark (deal desk) and the account owner can receive per-seat rates without approval. Hollis is the Central team lead, so a mail to him with the rate needs Anselm's or June's OK, even as a draft.

What I did:
1. **Checked Hollis in the directory:** he's at hmbeki@pemberline.com. That's an internal address, so the rule on outside mail doesn't come into it.
2. **Asked June to approve:** I sent her a direct message and left the $2,356 figure out. I also logged the approval request.
3. **Showed you the draft:** I posted it in our DM so you can check the wording. It's addressed to Hollis with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate". It gives the $2,356-per-seat proposed 2027 rate for the territory review and notes that it came from your call yesterday.

Once June approves, I'll save the draft for you to send yourself. If she declines, nothing gets saved. I couldn't see any Quarrendon account files, so I couldn't check the account ownership. I'm relying on what you told me.
I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.

I've made a note that you're travelling tomorrow morning (Thursday 15 October) and can be reached on mobile, Ilse. I checked the calendar and I can't see any meetings for you tomorrow, so there's nothing to move. If anything comes up for you in here, I'll point people to your mobile.
Dana told me the Quarrendon Freight Lines proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. Fine by me for Hollis to get it: go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
